turns.userText:
Repair and extend the H3Act offline evidence pipeline in `/workspace/project`.
Its typed payload models, frame adapter and client replay must work together
with compressed byte expressions and the ori

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && find project -maxdepth 4 -type f -printf '%p\n' | sort && echo '--- sample' && cat sample.json

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace/project && cat README.md && echo --- && cat LICENSE | head

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace/project && python3 -m py_compile $(find . -name '*.py') && echo OK && wc -l main.py schema.py modules/*.py && git diff --stat 2>/dev/null || true

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace/project && python3 -m py_compile $(find . -name '*.py') && cd /workspace && python3 check.py /workspace/project && cd /workspace/project && python

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && python3 check.py /workspace/project && cd /workspace/project && python3 -B main.py < /workspace/sample.json > /tmp/sample.out && python3 - <<'P

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace/project && echo 'not json' | python3 -B main.py; echo status=$?

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace/project && grep -R "sleep\|socket\|requests\|urllib" -n main.py schema.py modules | head -50

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace/project && find . -type d -name '__pycache__' -prune -exec rm -rf {} + && find . -maxdepth 3 -printf '%y %s %p\n' | sort

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace/project && echo symlinks: && find . -type l -print && echo other: && find . ! -type f ! -type d -print && echo files: && find . -type f | wc -l &&
